answer: Think of each agent record as a garden that only grows through verified work: before any payout, a random sample of its recent jobs is re-executed by independent peers on a mesa of open checkpoints, so a claim that cannot be reproduced is discarded. Running one fake identity is cheap, but farming a dune of identities means redoing real work for every one of them, and each failed re-check burns the escrow behind that identity, so sybil scale stops paying.
